channel.title: Cult of Mac - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cult of Mac (cultofmac.com)

item.title: Today in Apple history: Macintosh LC II is the Mac mini of its day
item.description: On March 23, 1992, Apple released the Macintosh LC II, a low-cost “headless” Macintosh that was roughly analogous to today’s Mac minis.

item.title: Price cut: Rescue old logos and other artwork with Super Vectorizer Pro, just $17
item.description: You can convert old images -- think logos, clip art and scanned sketches -- into clean vector graphics with Super Vectorizer Pro.

item.title: Apple sets June dates for WWDC26 and its next major software updates
item.description: Apple sets June dates for WWDC26, its major conference where it will unveil the next versions of iOS, macOS, iPadOS, watchOS, tvOS and visionOS.

item.title: Apple plans to bring ads to Maps app this summer
item.description: Seems like it had to happen eventually, right? Apple plans to bring ads to Maps on all devices and online, probably in summer 2026.

item.title: Why now is the best time to buy a portable SSD
item.description: SSD price trends make now the right time to add storage to your Mac ... before costs rise even further. Prices are going up and staying up.

item.title: Price cut: $43 bundle preps you for major cybersecurity certifications
item.description: The Ultimate Cybersecurity Training Bundle preps you for certification exams for CompTIA and Microsoft for less than $43.

item.title: 5 ways to get the best battery life on your MacBook
item.description: Every MacBook boasts industry-leading battery life. How could one possibly need more battery life, and how do you get it?

item.title: If you think faster than you type, try this $50 Mac dictation app
item.description: You can talk instead of typing -- faster, offline and privately -- in any app on your Mac with the Voibe dictation app.

item.title: New iPhone hacking tool puts hundreds of millions of devices at risk [Updated]
item.description: Recently discovered DarkSword iPhone hacking tool, which could infect hundreds of millions of devices, just became a bigger problem.

item.title: This iPad stand does double-duty as 5-port hub [Review]
item.description: Your iPad can be the heart of a compact workstation with the Satechi OntheGo Foldable Stand Hub. We go hands-on.
